title: EU Climate & Energy Daily Briefing
subtitle: Saturday, 26 September 2026 — Key developments from the last 24 hours

highlights.headline: Germany news: Parliament approves fuel tax cut
highlights.summary: German lawmakers hope to drive down fuel prices by cutting taxes on gas and diesel from October 1. Meanwhile, Germany's defense minister visited Budapest to ramp up defense and military ties.

highlights.headline: ‘Concerning’ low sea ice persists as Antarctic hits third-lowest winter peak

items.title: India news: Protests against election chief escalate as Gandhi, Cockroach party allege 'rigged' vote
items.description: Police have used tear gas on protests by the opposition Congress party demanding India's election commission head steps down, following a report alleging "rigged" elections.
